parsed.internal_thinking: Alice used a Monopoly on Wheat. She took 3 Wheat from me, leaving me with 2 Wood and 1 Sheep. This is a targeted strike to punish me for my 'merchant' persona and to prevent me from using the 4:1 bank trade I was setting up. With Charlie blocking my Brick and Alice taking my Wheat, I am being completely boxed out. I need to play it cool and not show how much this hurts my momentum.
parsed.note_to_self: Alice played Monopoly on Wheat, taking 3 from me. Alice now has at least 4 Wheat. My Wheat supply is gone, delaying my expansion to the Node 3 port.
parsed.say_outloud: Ouch, Alice. I guess 'literally' is one way to put it. I suppose I should be flattered you think I'm that good of a provider.
